questions.q: What metaphor does Chet Holmes use to stress regular sales training?
questions.why: He compares training to a lumberjack sharpening his saw weekly.

questions.q: What is the recommended focus when targeting big-company prospects?
questions.why: He advises focusing on the few key decision makers rather than mass outreach.

questions.q: What does Holmes suggest selling beyond the product itself?
questions.why: He says to sell the whole store, brand, story, not just the product.

questions.q: How often does Holmes recommend sales staff training?
questions.why: He emphasizes regular, ongoing training rather than annual events.

questions.q: What was Chet Holmes' age at death?
questions.why: The overview notes he died at the young age of 55.
